rows.grounds: dative form of the seed-syllable designation ā, continuing the salutation sequence
compound of tathā and ekakūṭeśvarī-ambā in dative, naming the goddess addressed
prescriptive optative directing the practitioner to speak the formula

items.question: What salutation formula must the practitioner utter to Ekakūṭeśvarī Ambā in continuation of the preceding invocation?
premises: The preceding context establishes a sequence of salutations to divine forms.
The dative forms āyai and tathaikakūṭeśvaryambādevyai specify the recipients of reverence.
The optative vadet prescribes the utterance of the salutation namo.
items.inference: The practitioner should utter the salutation 'namo' to Ā and likewise to Ekakūṭeśvarī Ambā.
uncertainties: The precise ritual identity or placement of the syllable ā within the Śrīvidyā mantra sequence is not fully specified in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: One should likewise utter 'obeisance' to Ā and to Ekakūṭeśvarī Ambā.
